updates.title: Island fit fix, billing Active unlock, vibe-audit clear

sections.heading: Widget
fixes: Small island host region matches CSS corner radius and height so the white top crescent is gone; Dashboard stays reachable on the compact layout.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Billing status shows Active with green styling after Stripe confirms, and Analyze, Protect, and VPN require that Active license.
fixes: Opening Billing re-hydrates the shared host license so a finished checkout flips Status to Active without a restart.

sections.heading: Site
added: Contact form posts to a validating contact API; llms.txt, sitemap, OG/Twitter tags, Delexoo attribution, and NuGet lockfiles match the live $3/month product.
fixes: Paid APIs use origin allow-lists plus per-IP rate limits; analyze routes accept an optional SECURELY_ANALYZE_KEY.

sections.heading: Security
added: Vibe-audit Missing and Warning items are resolved in source (contact validation, CORS, rate limits, lockfiles, consistent pricing facts).

updates.title: Stripe promo unlock, VirusTotal harden, Credits repos

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Billing unlocks from Stripe session polling and a shared host license file so promo checkouts activate the pill without relying on WebView postMessage.
Credits lists the GitHub repos Securely uses or patterns after, including VirusTotal, WireGuard, Tesseract, and WebView2.
fixes: Subscribe with a promo code now flips Billing to Active and unlocks scans on the island.

sections.heading: API
added: Checkout returns sessionId for desktop unlock polling.
Analyze follows VirusTotal vt-py/vt-cli patterns: lookup, submit unknown URLs, poll analyses, richer engine stats.

sections.heading: Host
added: LicenseStore shares entitlement across dashboard and island WebViews via license-get and license-set.

updates.title: Nord-style VPN with live IP, WireGuard tunnel, sharper island

sections.heading: VPN
added: VPN channel uses a Nord-style map with live public IP, city, Secured state, region pins, and Recents.
Connect drives a real WireGuard tunnel from a BYO .conf (Algo, PiVPN, Amnezia, Firezone) via the host.
ip-geo API returns public IP and coarse geolocation so the map updates after connect.

sections.heading: Antivirus
added: Protect scans pick files in the host and run Windows Defender MpCmdRun plus SHA-256 reputation through Analyze.

sections.heading: Widget
added: Default layout is the small Dynamic Island with scan and tool buttons only — logo mark removed.

sections.heading: Host
fixes: Installer wizard logos are regenerated from the high-res mark on charcoal so rounded edges stay crisp.

updates.title: Analyze, Antivirus, and VPN dashboard channels

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Analyze channel lets you paste a link or drop a file for hash-first reputation and heuristic harm checks.
Antivirus channel adds Quiet/Balanced/Paranoid profiles, Downloads watch, Defender deep-link, and multi-file scan.
VPN channel adds one-tap Connect with region, kill switch, split tunnel, and optional WireGuard BYO config.

sections.heading: API
added: analyze-threat endpoint aggregates local heuristics, optional VirusTotal, URLhaus, and an AI summary for URLs and file hashes.

updates.title: Timed duration, appearance sync, educated audit details

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Timed duration appears when Timed mode is selected; Monitoring no longer shows Start/Stop under Status — use the pill.
Appearance controls sync the island look and brightness live through the host.
Audit log rows open a detail view with screenshot (when captured), summary, and protection tips for suspicious or phishing findings.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Billing is one Subscribe with Stripe button — email, promo, Activate, and Manage fields are gone; Stripe Checkout and the portal handle the rest.

sections.heading: Site
added: Pricing is a single Subscribe with Stripe button; Checkout collects email and promo codes on Stripe’s page.

updates.title: Solid widget chrome — no halo, no clipped tools

sections.heading: Widget
added: Island layouts use tighter fit sizing with real measured height so scan and tool buttons are no longer cut off.
Vertical reshape is wider; small and big squares get more padding; outer drop-shadow and frame pad are removed for a clean solid edge.
fixes: Host no longer forces a 160px minimum width, which left a soft halo beside compact layouts.

updates.title: Rounded Securely logo in the installer

sections.heading: Host
added: Installer wizard logo tiles use a rounded squircle shield mark with transparent corners instead of a hard square.

updates.title: Securely logo on the Windows installer

sections.heading: Host
added: The Inno Setup wizard uses the Securely shield logo in the title-bar setup icon and the top-right / welcome wizard images instead of the default package art.

updates.title: Bold Music Widget look and reshape layouts

sections.heading: Widget
added: The island uses a solid Music Widget charcoal palette with a shield mark tile and white circular tool buttons — no translucent glass.
A reshape control cycles the pill through small square, vertical rectangle, big square, and back to the normal horizontal widget — each layout has its own arrangement.

updates.title: Instant billing unlock, broader privacy gate, power-suite research

sections.heading: Core
added: The local sensitive gate covers more categories — emails, phones, DOB, government and medical IDs, tax IDs, crypto seeds, OTP/recovery codes, private network IDs, and biometric cues — before any AI upload.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: After Stripe Checkout, the Credits tab flips to Active immediately via checkout-status, opener postMessage, and a short license poll — no manual re-activate wait.
fixes: Subscribe opens checkout without noopener so the success page can notify the dashboard.

sections.heading: API
added: New checkout-status endpoint confirms a Stripe session and returns subscription status for instant app unlock.

sections.heading: Site
added: Billing success auto-confirms the session and posts securely-checkout-done back to the opener dashboard.
docs/power-suite research pack maps Analyze, Defender-companion AV, WireGuard VPN, and real-time roadmap with a Phase 1 build prompt.

sections.heading: Security
added: Threat model documents Analyze/VPN/AV data flows and honest claim limits versus Norton-class suites.
REA use is bounded to Securely and open targets — never commercial AV/VPN binaries.

updates.title: Local sensitive-data gate before AI scan

sections.heading: Core
added: Quick Scan runs a local detector for passwords, SSNs, payment details, and addresses before any AI upload.
If sensitive text is found, the pill prompts Stop or Continue — Continue redacts OCR and sends text only (no screenshot) to AI.
OCR+AI remains the classifier; local phishing cues and a one-retry analyze call harden reliability when OCR is strong.
fixes: Screen capture JPEG quality and width are raised slightly so Windows OCR reads more reliably.

sections.heading: Security
added: Sensitive screens are never uploaded unless the user explicitly continues after the local privacy warning.

updates.title: Securely installer, license, and always-latest download

sections.heading: Site
added: Windows Download always resolves to the latest Securely-Setup.exe on the site (with GitHub Release fallback).
Professional README, Securely License Agreement, and installer license screen branded only for Securely.

sections.heading: Host
added: Inno Setup package Securely-Setup ships the shell, UI, and Securely license acceptance.

sections.heading: Security
added: Local .env is Securely-only (example file documents product secrets without other-brand names).

updates.title: Production API host for scans and billing

sections.heading: API
added: The desktop app talks to the live trysecurely.vercel.app APIs for analyze, license, checkout, and portal until trysecurely.com DNS is attached.

sections.heading: Site
fixes: Vercel deploys ignore large leftover folders under Securely-Website so production stays under the size limit.

updates.title: Real Quick Scan, billing promo, tighter dashboard

sections.heading: Widget
added: Quick Scan captures the primary screen, runs Windows OCR, and classifies Safe / Warning / Phishing via the site analyze API.
Scan sounds play through the host so done and alert chimes work after the click gesture.
Pill is slightly taller with a wider Quick/Timed/24/7 scan control.
fixes: Dashboard opens from the pill only for subscription activation, not during a normal scan.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Billing form stacks Stripe email and optional SECURELY-DEV promo, then starts Checkout from the app.
fixes: Billing email field no longer overlaps its label; main panel padding fits the window.

sections.heading: API
added: OpenRouter /api/analyze proxy accepts OCR text and optional screenshot for threat classification.
Checkout accepts promo SECURELY-DEV for 100% off when STRIPE_PROMO_ID is configured.

sections.heading: Site
added: Pricing page includes an optional promo field for SECURELY-DEV.

updates.title: Hooxie-style shell with colored scan modes

sections.heading: Widget
added: Compact island with SVG toolbar icons and a colored scan pill: red Quick, green Timed, blue 24/7 (right-click cycles mode).
Drag uses host cursor-follow so the pill can move the full working area without an invisible border.
fixes: Scan and window chrome no longer rely on emoji glyphs.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Hooxie-style light sidebar dashboard for Monitoring, Settings, Audit log, and Credits.
Release notes appear in the dashboard About section from the same brain log as the website.

sections.heading: Site
added: Release notes pipeline from brain/log.json into the website and GitHub Releases on commit/deploy.
